feature_queries.name: user_profile_geo
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.user, e.timestamp, u.locale, u.gender, u.birthyear, u.timezone,
       date_diff('day', u.joinedAt, e.timestamp) AS days_since_joined,
       CASE WHEN u.location IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE regexp_extract(u.location, ',\s*([A-Z]{2})$', 1) END AS user_state
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.user

feature_queries.name: attendance_core_plus
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table),
att AS (
  SELECT b.user, b.timestamp, a.event, a.status, a.start_time
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN event_attendees a
    ON a.user_id=b.user
   AND a.start_time < b.timestamp
   AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days'
)
SELECT
  user, timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS attend_7d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS attend_14d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS attend_30d,
  COUNT(*) AS attend_60d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS distinct_events_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event) AS distinct_events_60d,
  MIN(date_diff('day', start_time, timestamp)) AS days_since_last_attend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS yes_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='maybe' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS maybe_30d
FROM att
GROUP BY user, timestamp

feature_queries.name: attendance_ratios
feature_queries.sql:
WITH core AS (
  SELECT
    b.user, b.timestamp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.start_time < b.timestamp AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS attend_7d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.start_time < b.timestamp AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS attend_14d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status='yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE a.start_time < b.timestamp AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS yes_14d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.status='maybe' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE a.start_time < b.timestamp AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days') AS maybe_14d
  FROM eval_table b
  LEFT JOIN event_attendees a
    ON a.user_id=b.user
   AND a.start_time < b.timestamp
   AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days'
  GROUP BY b.user, b.timestamp
)
SELECT
  user, timestamp,
  CASE WHEN attend_14d>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_attend_14d,
  attend_7d * 1.0 / NULLIF(attend_14d,0) AS attend_7_over_14,
  yes_14d * 1.0 / NULLIF(attend_14d,0) AS yes_rate_14d,
  maybe_14d * 1.0 / NULLIF(attend_14d,0) AS maybe_rate_14d
FROM core

feature_queries.name: attendance_diversity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table),
att AS (
  SELECT b.user, b.timestamp, a.event, a.start_time
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN event_attendees a
    ON a.user_id=b.user
   AND a.start_time < b.timestamp
   AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days'
)
SELECT
  user, timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS attend_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS distinct_events_30d,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')>0
       THEN COUNT(DISTINCT event) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')*1.0 / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE start_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')
       ELSE 0.0 END AS distinct_over_total_30d,
  COUNT(*) AS attend_60d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event) AS distinct_events_60d,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT event)*1.0/COUNT(*) ELSE 0.0 END AS distinct_over_total_60d
FROM att
GROUP BY user, timestamp

feature_queries.name: event_content_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table),
recent AS (
  SELECT b.user, b.timestamp, a.event, a.status
  FROM base b
  JOIN event_attendees a
    ON a.user_id=b.user
   AND a.start_time < b.timestamp
   AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days'
   AND a.status IN ('yes','maybe')
),
joined AS (
  SELECT r.user, r.timestamp, r.status, ev.country, ev.state,
         COALESCE(ev.c_1,0) AS c1, COALESCE(ev.c_2,0) AS c2, COALESCE(ev.c_3,0) AS c3,
         COALESCE(ev.c_4,0) AS c4, COALESCE(ev.c_5,0) AS c5, COALESCE(ev.c_6,0) AS c6
  FROM recent r
  JOIN events ev ON ev.event_id = r.event
)
SELECT
  user, timestamp,
  COUNT(*) AS attended_yesmaybe_60d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='yes') AS attended_yes_60d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='maybe') AS attended_maybe_60d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS n_countries_60d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS n_states_60d,
  SUM(c1) AS sum_c1_60d,
  SUM(c2) AS sum_c2_60d,
  SUM(c3) AS sum_c3_60d,
  SUM(c4) AS sum_c4_60d,
  SUM(c5) AS sum_c5_60d,
  SUM(c6) AS sum_c6_60d
FROM joined
GROUP BY user, timestamp

feature_queries.name: geo_match
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table),
user_state AS (
  SELECT e.user, e.timestamp,
         CASE WHEN u.location IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE regexp_extract(u.location, ',\s*([A-Z]{2})$', 1) END AS user_state
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id=e.user
),
recent_states AS (
  SELECT b.user, b.timestamp, ev.state
  FROM base b
  JOIN event_attendees a
    ON a.user_id=b.user
   AND a.start_time < b.timestamp
   AND a.start_time >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days'
   AND a.status IN ('yes','maybe')
  JOIN events ev ON ev.event_id=a.event
),
agg AS (
  SELECT user, timestamp, MODE(state) AS mode_event_state_60d
  FROM recent_states
  GROUP BY user, timestamp
)
SELECT
  us.user, us.timestamp,
  a.mode_event_state_60d,
  CASE WHEN us.user_state IS NULL OR a.mode_event_state_60d IS NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN us.user_state = a.mode_event_state_60d THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS state_match_mode_60d
FROM user_state us
LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.user=us.user AND a.timestamp=us.timestamp

feature_queries.name: friend_degree
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT user, timestamp FROM eval_table),
fr AS (SELECT user, COUNT(*) AS friend_count FROM user_friends GROUP BY user)
SELECT b.user, b.timestamp, COALESCE(fr.friend_count,0) AS friend_count
FROM base b LEFT JOIN fr ON fr.user=b.user
